candidates.title: Move destructive migration after draining legacy image consumers
candidates.problem: The release entrypoint drops legacy_name before rolling out the new image. The documented old image still reads that column until rollout finishes, so this ordering violates its compatibility contract; no deployment or outage was observed.
candidates.fix: Split rollout and destructive cleanup, then gate cleanup on confirmation that old-image consumers are drained.

candidates.root_cause: release entrypoint places the named destructive migration before new-image rollout
candidates.affected_boundary: ci/release.sh migration -> image rollout -> documented legacy consumers
candidates.verification: Proposed: in an isolated release rehearsal, assert old product_names readers remain compatible through rollout and drain, forbid DROP COLUMN before confirmed drain, and verify interruption and rollback before and after cleanup with column/data restoration after drop. No rehearsal ran here.
candidates.invariant: The old image reads legacy_name until the new image has finished rolling out; drop legacy_name only after the old image is drained.
candidates.scenario: During the documented rollout topology, release.sh removes legacy_name before rolling out the new image while old_image/products.py still selects legacy_name. An old-image product_names call in that interval targets a dropped column.

candidates.flow: release.sh builds REVISION, applies migrations/002_drop_legacy.sql, then calls rollout_image for REVISION. That migration explicitly drops products.legacy_name, which old_image/products.py selects. docs/contracts.md:6 states the old image remains a reader until rollout finishes and requires drain before drop.
remediation: Deploy the compatible new image while retaining legacy_name and its data.
Deploy the compatible new image and confirm old-image consumers are drained before allowing destructive cleanup.
Provide and verify column/data restoration for rollback after cleanup; rehearse interrupted rollout and both rollback phases.
candidates.compatibility: Maintain legacy_name and its data for old-image consumers until drain; preserve the existing REVISION artifact identity between build and rollout.
candidates.rollback: Before drop use the previous image; after drop restore legacy_name and its data before running that image, as required by docs/contracts.md:7.
